opening.argument: The video shows a seller-support workflow: an automatic message sends buyers installation instructions and warranty information after a qualifying purchase. The speaker explains that an item-title rule triggers the message when a title contains “car” and “radio,” and the interface shows the rule and the resulting warranty-and-instructions message. The description promotes access to the tools, but the demonstrated communication is post-purchase customer service, not an investment offer or a request for viewer payment or credentials. Nothing in the cited material shows a deceptive solicitation or establishes losses, intent, or downstream outcomes.

citations.quote: So let's make an automatic message that sends buyers installation instructions and a warranty when they make a purchase.
each time that a title contains car and the title contains radio, this message will send to the buyer a link to their warranty and a link to their instructions.
